title: Discounts
statementMd:
One day Polycarpus stopped by a supermarket on his way home. It turns out that the supermarket is having a special offer for stools. The offer is as follows: if a customer's shopping cart contains at least one stool, the customer gets a $50%$ discount on the cheapest item in the cart (that is, it becomes two times cheaper). If there are several items with the same minimum price, the discount is available for only one of them!

Polycarpus has $*k*$ carts, and he wants to buy up all stools and pencils from the supermarket. Help him distribute the stools and the pencils among the shopping carts, so that the items' total price (including the discounts) is the least possible.

Polycarpus must use all $*k*$ carts to purchase the items, no shopping cart can remain empty. Each shopping cart can contain an arbitrary number of stools and/or pencils.

## Input

The first input line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{3}$) — the number of items in the supermarket and the number of carts, correspondingly. Next $*n*$ lines describe the items as "$*c*_{*i*}$ $*t*_{*i*}$" (without the quotes), where $*c*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) is an integer denoting the price of the $*i*$-th item, $*t*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 2$) is an integer representing the type of item $*i*$ ($1$ for a stool and $2$ for a pencil). The numbers in the lines are separated by single spaces.

## Output

In the first line print a single real number **with exactly one ** decimal place — the minimum total price of the items, including the discounts.

In the following $*k*$ lines print the descriptions of the items in the carts. In the $*i*$-th line print the description of the $*i*$-th cart as "$*t*$ $*b*_{1}$ $*b*_{2}$ $...$ $*b*_{*t*}$" (without the quotes), where $*t*$ is the number of items in the $*i*$-th cart, and the sequence $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*t*}$ ($1 ≤ *b*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$) gives the indices of items to put in this cart in the optimal distribution. All indices of items in all carts should be pairwise different, each item must belong to exactly one cart. You can print the items in carts and the carts themselves in any order. The items are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$ in the order in which they are specified in the input.

If there are multiple optimal distributions, you are allowed to print any of them.

## Note

In the first sample case the first cart should contain the 1st and 2nd items, and the second cart should contain the 3rd item. This way each cart has a stool and each cart has a $50%$ discount for the cheapest item. The total price of all items will be: $2·0.5 + (3 + 3·0.5) = 1 + 4.5 = 5.5$.
statementZhMd:
一天，Polycarpus 在回家途中顺便去了超市。原来，这家超市正在对凳子进行特别促销。促销规则如下：如果顾客的购物车中至少有一把凳子，那么顾客可以对购物车中最便宜的商品享受 $50%$ 的折扣（也就是价格变为原来的两倍便宜）。如果有多个商品的价格同为最低，则折扣只能用于其中一个商品！

Polycarpus 有 $*k*$ 个购物车，他想买下超市中的所有凳子和铅笔。请帮助他将凳子和铅笔分配到购物车中，使商品的总价格（包括折扣）尽可能低。

Polycarpus 必须使用全部 $*k*$ 个购物车购买这些商品，不能有购物车为空。每个购物车可以包含任意数量的凳子和/或铅笔。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{3}$）——超市中的商品数量和购物车数量。接下来 $*n*$ 行，每行以 "$*c*_{*i*}$ $*t*_{*i*}$"（不含引号）的格式描述一个商品，其中 $*c*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）是一个整数，表示第 $*i*$ 件商品的价格；$*t*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 2$）是一个整数，表示第 $*i*$ 件商品的类型（$1$ 表示凳子，$2$ 表示铅笔）。每行中的数字由单个空格分隔。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个实数，**恰好保留一位**小数，表示包括折扣在内的商品最低总价。

接下来的 $*k*$ 行输出各购物车中的商品描述。第 $*i*$ 行按照 "$*t*$ $*b*_{1}$ $*b*_{2}$ $...$ $*b*_{*t*}$"（不含引号）的格式输出第 $*i*$ 个购物车的描述，其中 $*t*$ 是第 $*i*$ 个购物车中的商品数量，序列 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*t*}$（$1 ≤ *b*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$）表示在最优分配中放入该购物车的商品编号。所有购物车中的商品编号必须两两不同，每件商品必须恰好属于一个购物车。你可以按照任意顺序输出购物车中的商品以及各个购物车。商品编号按照它们在输入中出现的顺序从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 编号。

如果存在多个最优分配，输出其中任意一种即可。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，第一个购物车应包含第 1 件和第 2 件商品，第二个购物车应包含第 3 件商品。这样每个购物车中都有一把凳子，并且每个购物车中最便宜的商品都可以享受 $50%$ 的折扣。所有商品的总价格为：$2·0.5 + (3 + 3·0.5) = 1 + 4.5 = 5.5$。
